subject: add_tooltip makes some points to vanish

messages.author: c4dab42e0a3383d8
messages.subject: add_tooltip makes some points to vanish
parts:
Hi!
When I add tooltips, some (seemingly arbitrary) points disappear after 1 s aprox.
For instance, using the mtcars dataset:

mtcars %>% 
  ggvis(~wt, ~mpg, fill = ~factor(cyl)) %>% 
  layer_points(key := ~disp ) %>% 
  add_tooltip(function(df) df$displ)

Points at rows 1,5,10, 12 and 13 disappear...

I am using ggvis 0.3.0.1 on linux with R 3.1.1.

Does that occur to someone else? 
Thx! Mathieu

messages.author: d34d025a513c07fc
messages.subject: Re: add_tooltip makes some points to vanish
parts:
Hi - this happens when the key isn't unique. You can add a new column
called "id" with unique keys like so:

mtcars %>% dplyr::mutate(id = 1:n()) %>%

layer_points(key := ~id) %>%
add_tooltip(function(df) df$displ)

That said, it probably would be good for ggvis to give a warning when
non-unique keys are used, since we've seen this issue come up before.

-Winston

messages.author: c4dab42e0a3383d8
messages.subject: Re: add_tooltip makes some points to vanish
parts:
Dear Winston,
Thank you very much for the reply.
I could not get your code to work, it seems to me that the function used in add_tooltip should make use of the key variable.
The following slight modification works fine:

mtc=mtcars %>% dplyr::mutate(id = 1:dim(mtcars)[1])
mtc  %>%

add_tooltip(function(df) mtc$disp[mtc$id==df$id])

though I don't know if something simpler for the specification of the function in add_tooltip could be used...

Thank you very much for your help, and for the great work on ggvis, which is an awesome package, I am using more and more!

Mathieu
